scope: Native USD/PhysX reauthoring; source appearance licenses retained; no Isaac physics acceptance claimed
appearance_and_modifications: Battery appearance is a clipped derivative of YCB035_power_drill, Google 16k, CC BY 4.0. Attribution: Berk Calli, Arjun Singh, Aaron Walsman, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Pieter Abbeel and Aaron Dollar, Yale-CMU-Berkeley Object and Model Set. Source https://ycb-benchmarks.s3.amazonaws.com/data/google/035_power_drill_google_16k.tgz ; license https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Cropping retains original UVs/texture. `SOURCES.json` records the derivative; the receiver, rail, button and hook are original nominal geometry.
physical_conversion_limits: Native load transfer, catch retention, spring-button force, station reach and full-score demonstrations remain untested. The visual scan is real, but its hidden rail, mating surfaces and receiver are original nominal geometry. The collision case approximates the scan and does not model deformation or battery contents. Pad support and hand clearance are geometric proxies; they are not force or contact measurements.
